shuttle-tatting.name: shuttle-tatting
notes: Two closed-point shuttle plates are connected by an internal post with wound thread. Side gap is real geometry. Original enlarged three-ring lace and picots are semantic technique evidence, not a working tatting pattern or knot-level model. No hand pose is implied.

stuffed-applique.name: stuffed-applique
notes: Raised stuffed fabric oval is attached at its perimeter to an intact foundation swatch. Twenty representative attachment stitches enter near the edge of the cushion and the foundation. Layered padding and broad coherent shading distinguish it from flat applique. This is not the exact class pattern or a stitch-by-stitch construction guide.
